answer: Problem: free identities flood payouts. Mechanism: each new agent must post a refundable 40-token anchor bond held 3 epochs, and its sable-listed first votes count at quarter weight until two unrelated peers confirm its work. Cost: a 500-identity farm locks 20,000 tokens. Verification: velvet-rope audits sample 5% of votes, checking funding-graph overlap. Failure: shared-funder clusters forfeit bonds.
